Hi Tom / Mina —

Thanks for the details. A few technical prep notes and asks so the session is productive:
- Runbook & repo: please review the pre-read in the shared Drive (link below). I will push a short test_harness_readme.md with example curl commands and a containerized harness we use for throughput runs.
- Latency SLOs: we'll aim to validate 95p latency < 220ms for the target prompt mix. If the long-tail prompts exceed this we can route them to a larger context model or kick them to an async batch path.
- KV cache warmup: for stable latency we recommend a 15–20 minute warmup at 30% of target qps before the main run to populate KV caches and steady batching behavior.
- Batching: we'll test with small micro-batches first (batch size 4–8) and increase to the optimal for the observed token distribution.
- Test harness access: we need either API key(s) for a sandbox endpoint or access to an IP-allowlisted test host. Can you share the egress IPs and a short-lived key?
